vulnerability.explanation: memmove is called with length (toaddr - addr - count) cast to size_t without ensuring addr + count <= toaddr or that addr/count are within the section. If addr + count > toaddr, the subtraction underflows to a huge size_t, causing out-of-bounds read/write on the heap-allocated section contents buffer.
